title: Scenario runner: a summary command reads many run records and prints one author-model × ask-model table
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M3 row of its milestone table, Blocked-by M2, which closed 2026-11-16 with #33818). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

The runner writes one record per card per run (`runRecord` in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts`) and renders one scorecard per card (`renderScorecard`). Nothing reads several records together. The record already states the served author and ask models (`Run · model`, `askSpend`, `authorCost`), the prompt choice (#33743), the ask repeats (#33741) and the mode (#33742).

## Why it matters

The M2 close-out cross matrix (opus build × haiku / sonnet ask, on the same build via `--modes ask`) and the cloud-default question ("is haiku good enough") need one table across runs. Today eval#1 assembles it by hand from record files, which is slow and easy to get wrong.

## Done when

- A subcommand (e.g. `objectstack-scenarios summary <records…|dir>`) reads run records and prints a markdown table: rows = author model, columns = ask model (or the reverse, stated), cells = Build, Run-问数 and operations pass counts with k/N when repeats were asked, plus ask cost and time per cell.
- Records that differ in a dimension the table does not show (card, prompt choice, package version, mode) are kept apart or refused with a line naming the difference, never summed together silently.
- A record from before a field existed reads `not recorded` in that cell.
- Deterministic and offline: it reads files only.
- Tests pin a 2×2 matrix from fixture records, a refusal on mixed prompt choices, and an older record.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M3 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue multi-run summary scenario` → 14 hits; #33923 (closed) put the round runbook in the eval seat skill, none adds a cross-record table to the runner.
